title: A Letter for the Atlas
author: Freya Vane
blurb: Freya Sandoval, a code-carrying courier on the last diplomatic mission of a doomed republic, measures the world in what can be carried when the orders come. Then the census taker asks one question too many — and she is pulled straight into the middle of it. Now she must finish the work while the workshop still stands, and time is already running out.
style: warm, character-driven storytelling with gentle humor
